subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should maintainers require a redacted OpenWebUI image-upload request capture before repair, or sponsor a source-backed routing fix for text-default/imageModel chat-completions images now?
rationale: The current source shows a plausible remaining routing gap, but the issue is labeled no-new-fix-pr/needs-maintainer-review and the exact OpenWebUI wire payload is still missing.

options.title: Capture before repair
options.body: Ask for or run a redacted OpenWebUI request capture first, then patch the exact drop point with focused regression coverage.

options.title: Sponsor routing fix now
options.body: Treat the text-default/imageModel inline-image gap as sufficient source proof and implement a focused gateway/agent routing fix without waiting for a captured OpenWebUI payload.

recommendation.title: Capture before repair
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a redacted OpenWebUI request capture first, then patch the exact drop point with focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest current history on the OpenAI-compatible chat image parser and gateway HTTP surface.
